channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Norse Atlantic’s financial woes deepen: Flights cancelled, IndiGo deal ends, takeover talks on
item.description: Norse Atlantic’s financial crisis worsened as shares plunged, flights were cancelled and the airline disclosed talks over short-term financing and a possible takeover. Its wet-lease agreement with IndiGo has ended, while PIA has shifted cancelled Norse-operated routes to its own aircraft.

item.title: ‘To the dishes he washed’: On Jensen Huang's comeback, Denny's says 'something you just don't take off the menu'
item.description: The diner chain said its history with Jensen goes back much further, “to the dishes he washed, the guests he served and the work he still talks about with pride.”

item.title: SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million orbital compute modules: What it means for data centres in space
item.description: SpaceX has secured FCC approval to deploy 1 million orbital compute modules for data centres in space. The project, dubbed Starmind, aims to harness solar power but faces concerns over satellite collisions, atmospheric pollution and night-sky pollution.

item.title: Nvidia’s China link revealed? Investigation claims two US-based firms with Chinese owners are buying most advanced chips
item.description: Nvidia is selling its most cutting-edge chips to at least two companies that are US-based, but are actually controlled by Chinese-owned firms, a CBS News investigation found.

item.title: Mizuho, Avendus commence partnership a year after takeover announcement
item.description: Mizuho Securities and Avendus Capital have combined their operations following approvals, with Avendus retaining its brand and leadership team.

item.title: BNP Paribas moves up global systemic bank list, capital buffer rises
item.description: BNP PARIBAS-CAPITAL/:BNP Paribas moves up global systemic bank list, capital buffer rises

item.title: SpaceX Receives Government Approval to Launch Space Data Centers
item.description: The US Federal Communications Commission approved SpaceX’s request to launch as many as 1 million satellites for Elon Musk’s vision to build a network of data centers in orbit for complex artificial intelligence computing.

item.title: IPO on agenda: Tata Sons board to discuss listing plan at Monday's meeting
item.description: Tata Sons’ board agenda now includes an IPO plan, with a draft prospectus due within 90 days of shareholder approval and listing within the following 90 days.

item.title: Why Huawei convicted in US? How its Iran business triggered 7-yr legal battle - what it means for China’s tech goals
item.description: Huawei and three subsidiaries have been convicted in the US of 10 criminal counts, including bank fraud, money laundering and sanctions violations. A jury found the Chinese telecom giant misled banks over its Iran business.

item.title: LIC names third CFO this year amid senior management churn
item.description: Sonija M.S. takes charge of the insurer's finances as repeated leadership changes reshape its top management. LIC also appointed Meenakshi Malhotra as its appointed actuary.

item.title: Anthropic made record $81.3bn in IPO, but where the money is going? why public shareholders have little say?
item.description: Anthropic's record $81.3 billion IPO and $120 billion fundraising effort have created a massive AI war chest. But early investors, insiders and public shareholders have different stakes in the company.

item.title: Tata Steel open to revisiting APL Apollo deal structure after investor backlash
item.description: Tata Steel's management is discussing possible changes with APL Apollo after shareholders raised concerns over debt, valuations and the financial implications of the proposed transactions.

item.title: Wipro secures over $500 million contract from energy major BP
item.description: The deal spanning around seven years will bring an average of about $75 million in annual business for Wipro and see 3,000 BP employees move to the IT services company, offering a boost to CEO Srini Pallia’s growth efforts.

item.title: Air India CEO Tewolde targets ₹6,000 crore in savings under ‘one group’ push
item.description: The restructuring brings Air India and Air India Express closer through shared back-end functions while keeping their flying permits separate.

item.title: Who is Indu Swaroop, new CFO of Canara HSBC Life Insurance, taking over after Tarun Rustagi's resignation?
item.description: Indu Swaroop is a founding member of Canara HSBC Life Insurance and has been associated with the company since 2008. Before his elevation as CFO, he served as its Financial Controller, supporting the CFO and overseeing several critical aspects of the company's finance function.

item.title: Air India & Air India Express to operate under ‘One Air India Group’- What changes for passengers? What you should know?
item.description: Air India and Air India Express will operate under a ‘One Air India Group’ structure, targeting ₹6,000 crore in savings. Here's what changes for passengers.

item.title: Cognizant in talks to take over parts of S&P Global's Capital IQ ops
item.description: The deal could transfer about 1,500 employees in data and ops functions of S&amp;P Global's Capital IQ to Cognizant's payroll.&nbsp;

item.title: Tech Mahindra CEO Mohit Joshi on the company's next big goal: ‘Become a world-beating IT company’
item.description: Joshi said the first three years of the company's transformation were focused on achieving world-class standards and catching up with competitors. However, the company has made progress beyond that objective over the past year and is now looking to accelerate growth.

item.title: GTA VI made $3.79 billion in a day, but who really wins? Why Take-Two isn’t the only one cashing in on the record debut
item.description: GTA VI generated $3.79 billion in first-day sales, but Take-Two isn't the only winner. Gaming platforms, retailers and GTA Online could also benefit.

item.title: Mint Explainer | What Huang's return says about founder-led power
item.description: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang’s return has raised concerns around the power that singular individuals wield on specific industries. What are the challenges behind such founder-led power?

item.title: Who is behind China's $270 million AI server network? Fresh Alice Huang links emerge after US blacklists Megaspeed
item.description: The US has blacklisted Megaspeed amid scrutiny of Nvidia chip exports to China. Report finds Alice Huang's family-linked firms financed $270 million in AI servers.

item.title: ‘Zuckerberg in RSS attire’ posters: Meta, Congress hold talks amid claims of BJP bias, rising curbs on political posts
item.description: Meta executives hold talks with Congress leaders in New Delhi amid protests over social media content restrictions, account takedowns and allegations of political bias favouring the BJP.

item.title: Who is Balaji Thiagarajan? Meet Flipkart’s new interim CEO as Kalyan Krishnamurthy exits e-commerce giant
item.description: Balaji Thiagarajan is set to take over as the interim CEO of the Flipkart Group, the company said on Wednesday.

item.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy set to exit after 11 years, amid IPO delay
item.description: Flipkart’s chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan is set to take over as interim CEO. Krishnamurthy’s last day will be 4 December.

item.title: Who is Kalyan Krishnamurthy? Meet Flipkart CEO stepping down after nearly a decade at the helm; what’s next for him?
item.description: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is stepping down after more than 11 years at the company. While Flipkart has not disclosed the reason for his exit, what he plans to do next remains unclear.

item.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down next month; Walmart begins search for successor
item.description: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down on December 4, with Balaji Thiagarajan taking interim charge. The exit comes amid delays to the company's IPO plans and growing questions over its future strategy.

item.title: Tata Steel working on tweaking APL Apollo Tubes deal amid questions of fairness: Report
item.description: Tata Steel is reportedly considering changes to its proposed APL Apollo Tubes deal to address concerns from minority shareholders, potentially by reducing debt costs and restructuring APL Apollo’s debt. The transactions, subject to approvals, are expected to close in FY2027.

item.title: Equal heir? Lakshmi Venu takes TVS partition fight to Madras HC
item.description: Lakshmi Venu had sent a notice to her father asking him to give effect to a fair and lawful partition.

item.title: TVS feud: Lakshmi Venu moves Madras High Court for partition of Venu Srinivasan family assets
item.description: Lakshmi Venu has sued in the Madras High Court seeking partition of her branch of the TVS family’s joint assets. She says the 2020 family arrangement did not divide assets within her immediate family and alleges her brother received beneficial interests to the exclusion of her lawful share.

item.title: Black Friday is here—and it's no longer just a discount weekend for India's malls
item.description: Mall operators expect store sales to grow 15-20% this year, as retailers increasingly use the discount period to drive purchases beyond the festive season.

item.title: Debt wary Naveen Jindal picks a prudent growth path
item.description: For Naveen Jindal, India’s growing steel market offers enough opportunity without taking on too much financial risk. India’s steel capacity, now about 220 million tonnes, is expected to rise to 300 million tonnes by 2031, with the government aiming for 600 million tonnes by 2047.

item.title: Who is Richard McPhail? Meet Home Depot’s new CEO and a company veteran replacing Ted Decker | All you need to know
item.description: Home Depot has appointed Richard McPhail as its new CEO, succeeding Ted Decker, who stepped down after returning from medical leave. McPhail, a company veteran since 2005, previously served as CFO and has played a key role in its financial and business strategy.

item.title: New CEO Tewolde Gebremariam gets free hand from Tata Sons for Air India revamp: Report
item.description: Tata Sons has authorized Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam to overhaul management and improve performance. The airline’s plans include reducing expenses, adjusting routes affected by airspace closures, pursuing wide-body aircraft and examining ways to integrate operations.

item.title: Cult.fit’s Mukesh Bansal targets ₹10,000 crore revenue over next decade
item.description: Mukesh Bansal sees opportunities beyond gyms and apparel, with Cult.fit aiming to become a trusted companion that guides consumers through their broader health journeys.

item.title: Foxconn faces India insolvency case over unpaid vendor dues
item.description: While the dispute isn’t expected to derail Foxconn’s growth plans in India, it adds to the challenges as it competes with Tata Electronics for a bigger role in Apple's iPhone supply chain.
